rubric_basis: Shared five-factor learner-question-metadata 0–2, score D1 0–2 D2 3–5 D3 6–7 D4 8–10; current Physics topic draft explicitly covers D3 and D4 only, D1/D2 blueprint remains pending
method: For each original source candidate, show shortest valid route and alternative-route score sensitivity; do not treat author's scores as independent QRT disposition.

rows.shortest: Two equal masses start from rest; compute gravitational potential-energy difference as separation halves; divide gained KE across both moving stars; infer speed of either, checking symmetry.
rows.protected_W: Recognize total K=2×(mv²/2), not K of only one star, and use the finite 1/r potential change.
rows.alternate_short_route: Reduced-mass relative energy then center-of-mass half-speed; may reduce chain length, so independently evaluate score sensitivity.
rows.reason: Original source requires joining energy conservation, mutual gravity and equal-mass center-of-mass symmetry; not simply substituting constant g.
rows.rubric_version: Shared 5-factor provisional 0–2; Physics Blueprint v0.2.0 D3/D4 draft
